## Summary
Implement the BKT (Bayesian Knowledge Tracing) mastery update as an Inngest function triggered by `journey/attempt.recorded`, computing per-concept p_mastery and writing atomically to concept_mastery.

## User story
As a student, I want my mastery level to update automatically after each practice attempt, so that the system can track my knowledge growth and personalize my study experience.

## Why this matters
Without BKT updates, the entire mastery and practice loop is dead. No mastery data means no radar chart, no weak-area identification, no adaptive practice sessions, and no study queue. This is the foundation for all of E08.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Inngest function `journey/mastery-update` triggers on every `journey/attempt.recorded` event
- [ ] BKT update uses canonical parameters: p_init=0.10, p_transit=0.20, p_slip=0.10, p_guess=0.20
- [ ] p_mastery is clamped to [0.001, 0.999] — never exact 0 or 1, never NaN
- [ ] concept_mastery row upserted atomically via Supabase RPC (not read-modify-write)
- [ ] Emits `journey/mastery.updated` event with { student_id, concept_id, p_mastery, review_count }
- [ ] Batch attempts (multiple concepts per session) use Promise.allSettled, not Promise.all
- [ ] mastery_threshold = 0.95 exported as constant for downstream consumers
- [ ] Unit tests verify BKT math for correct/incorrect sequences and edge cases

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 3 (AP-03) | Promise.allSettled for batch mastery updates across multiple concepts per session |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Supabase-first: write concept_mastery to Supabase, then sync to Neo4j. Neo4j failure never blocks |
| Rule 11 (C03) | Atomic concept_mastery updates: SET review_count = review_count + 1, never read-modify-write |

## Schema changes
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.concept_mastery (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  student_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  concept_id UUID NOT NULL,
  p_mastery DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.10,
  review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  correct_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  streak INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(student_id, concept_id)
);

ALTER TABLE public.concept_mastery ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Students can read own mastery"
  ON public.concept_mastery FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = student_id);

-- Atomic upsert RPC
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_concept_mastery(
  p_student_id UUID,
  p_concept_id UUID,
  p_new_mastery DOUBLE PRECISION,
  p_is_correct BOOLEAN
) RETURNS public.concept_mastery AS $$
  INSERT INTO public.concept_mastery (student_id, concept_id, p_mastery, review_count, correct_count, last_reviewed_at, streak)
  VALUES (p_student_id, p_concept_id, p_new_mastery, 1, CASE WHEN p_is_correct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, now(), CASE WHEN p_is_correct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ON CONFLICT (student_id, concept_id) DO UPDATE SET
    p_mastery = p_new_mastery,
    review_count = concept_mastery.review_count + 1,
    correct_count = concept_mastery.correct_count + CASE WHEN p_is_correct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    last_reviewed_at = now(),
    streak = CASE WHEN p_is_correct THEN concept_mastery.streak + 1 ELSE 0 END,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *;
$$ LANGUAGE sql;

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## Inngest event context
Function: journey/mastery-update
Trigger: journey/attempt.recorded (from E07-S08)
Step 1: step.run('fetch-attempt-concepts', ...) — load attempt + associated concept IDs
Step 2: step.run('compute-bkt-updates', ...) — BKT math for each concept
Step 3: step.run('write-mastery', ...) — atomic upsert via Supabase RPC + Neo4j sync
Emits: journey/mastery.updated { student_id, concept_id, p_mastery, review_count }
onFailure: Log to dead letter queue, do not retry (stale BKT is better than duplicate)

## API contract
```
None — this is an Inngest background function, not an API route.
Events:
  IN:  journey/attempt.recorded { student_id, session_id, attempt_id, items: [{ item_id, concept_ids, is_correct }] }
  OUT: journey/mastery.updated { student_id, concept_id, p_mastery, review_count }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// packages/ai/src/mastery/bkt.ts
export const BKT_PARAMS = {
  p_init: 0.10,
  p_transit: 0.20,
  p_slip: 0.10,
  p_guess: 0.20,
} as const;

export const MASTERY_THRESHOLD = 0.95;

export function bktUpdate(
  priorMastery: number,
  isCorrect: boolean,
  params = BKT_PARAMS
): number {
  const { p_slip, p_guess, p_transit } = params;

  // Posterior given observation
  const pCorrectGivenMastered = 1 - p_slip;
  const pCorrectGivenUnmastered = p_guess;

  const pCorrect = priorMastery * pCorrectGivenMastered
    + (1 - priorMastery) * pCorrectGivenUnmastered;

  let posterior: number;
  if (isCorrect) {
    posterior = (priorMastery * pCorrectGivenMastered) / pCorrect;
  } else {
    posterior = (priorMastery * p_slip) / (1 - pCorrect);
  }

  // Apply learning transition
  const updated = posterior + (1 - posterior) * p_transit;

  // Clamp to (0, 1) — never exact 0 or 1
  return Math.max(0.001, Math.min(0.999, updated));
}

  }
);
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-03: Promise.all for batch Claude/mastery calls — one failure kills entire batch
await Promise.all(concepts.map(c => updateMastery(c))); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: await Promise.allSettled(concepts.map(c => updateMastery(c)));

// ✗ AP-10: CoverageRecord read-modify-write — race condition
const row = await supabase.from('concept_mastery').select().single();
row.review_count += 1;
await supabase.from('concept_mastery').update(row); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: supabase.rpc('upsert_concept_mastery', { ... })

// ✗ Unclamped mastery value
return posterior + (1 - posterior) * p_transit; // BANNED — could hit 0 or 1
// ✓ Use: Math.max(0.001, Math.min(0.999, updated))
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S01.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { bktUpdate, BKT_PARAMS, MASTERY_THRESHOLD } from '../../packages/ai/src/mastery/bkt';

test('BKT update: correct answer increases mastery', () => {
  const prior = 0.10;
  const updated = bktUpdate(prior, true);
  expect(updated).toBeGreaterThan(prior);
  expect(updated).toBeLessThan(1);
  expect(updated).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('BKT update: incorrect answer decreases mastery', () => {
  const prior = 0.50;
  const updated = bktUpdate(prior, false);
  expect(updated).toBeLessThan(prior);
  expect(updated).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('BKT update: mastery is always clamped to [0.001, 0.999]', () => {
  // Near-zero prior with wrong answer
  const low = bktUpdate(0.001, false);
  expect(low).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.001);

  // Near-one prior with correct answer
  const high = bktUpdate(0.999, true);
  expect(high).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.999);
});

test('BKT update: 10 consecutive correct answers from p_init reaches near-mastery', () => {
  let p = BKT_PARAMS.p_init;
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    p = bktUpdate(p, true);
  }
  expect(p).toBeGreaterThan(0.90);
});

test('BKT update: NaN inputs produce clamped output', () => {
  // Edge case: should not produce NaN
  const result = bktUpdate(0.5, true);
  expect(Number.isNaN(result)).toBe(false);
});

test('MASTERY_THRESHOLD is 0.95', () => {
  expect(MASTERY_THRESHOLD).toBe(0.95);
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.upsert_concept_mastery;`
2. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.concept_mastery CASCADE;`
3. No Neo4j changes to revert (sync is idempotent).
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
